short_description: VPN connection fails after firewall change
description: Remote users cannot establish SSL VPN sessions after a firewall policy update. Client connections time out during negotiation.
resolution_notes: Restored the VPN allow rule for TCP and UDP 443, disabled TLS inspection for the VPN gateway, and verified connectivity.
close_notes: VPN access restored for all tested users. Firewall change record updated.

description: Users report that outbound email remains in the Outbox and inbound messages arrive 20 to 30 minutes late.
resolution_notes: Restarted the mail transport service and cleared the blocked connector queue.
close_notes: Mail flow returned to normal and queue depth remained stable for 30 minutes.

description: Multiple finance users receive an authentication error when signing in to SAP after a scheduled identity synchronization.
resolution_notes: Re-ran identity synchronization and cleared stale SAP authentication cache entries.
close_notes: Affected users confirmed successful login.

description: Wireless clients on the third floor disconnect repeatedly and reconnect after several minutes.
resolution_notes: Rebooted the affected access point and changed the congested radio channel.
close_notes: Wireless stability confirmed during a one-hour observation period.

description: A company laptop requests the BitLocker recovery key after a firmware update.
resolution_notes: Retrieved the recovery key from device management, completed startup, and suspended then resumed BitLocker protection.
close_notes: Device restarted normally twice and user access was restored.

description: Application server VM responds to platform health checks but RDP and application ports are unavailable.
resolution_notes: Restarted the VM, removed a hung monitoring process, and increased available memory.
close_notes: Application health checks passed and service owner confirmed recovery.

description: Users in the Finance group receive access denied when opening the monthly reports shared folder.
resolution_notes: Restored the missing Finance security group permission on the shared folder and refreshed access tokens.
close_notes: Three affected users verified read and write access.

description: Documents remain in the print queue for the main office multifunction printer.
resolution_notes: Cleared the print spooler queue, restarted the spooler service, and reinstalled the printer driver.
close_notes: Test pages printed successfully from two workstations.

description: The customer portal database remains above 95 percent CPU and page loads are slow.
resolution_notes: Terminated a runaway reporting query, added a missing index, and updated query statistics.
close_notes: CPU returned below 40 percent and portal response time normalized.

description: Microsoft Teams does not detect the headset microphone although audio playback works.
resolution_notes: Enabled microphone privacy permission, selected the correct input device, and updated the audio driver.
close_notes: Test call completed with clear two-way audio.

description: The internal employee portal returns HTTP 503 for all users after an application deployment.
resolution_notes: Rolled back the failed release and restarted the application service instances.
close_notes: Portal availability and synthetic monitoring checks returned to normal.

description: A user can access Microsoft 365 with the new password but cannot sign in to an on-premises application.
resolution_notes: Forced directory synchronization and corrected the password writeback connector status.
close_notes: User successfully authenticated to both cloud and on-premises services.

description: The application server system drive reached 98 percent utilization and generated critical alerts.
resolution_notes: Removed obsolete log files, compressed archived logs, and increased the disk by 50 GB.
close_notes: Free space increased to 42 percent and monitoring alerts cleared.

description: Users intermittently cannot resolve internal application hostnames from one office subnet.
resolution_notes: Corrected the subnet DHCP option to use the active DNS servers and flushed local resolver caches.
close_notes: Repeated DNS tests succeeded from affected client devices.

description: Incident assignees do not receive email notifications when new tickets are assigned.
resolution_notes: Re-enabled the assignment notification rule and corrected the outbound email account configuration.
close_notes: Test incidents generated notifications for all selected recipients.

description: The nightly backup for the payroll server failed with a repository connection timeout.
resolution_notes: Restarted the backup proxy, renewed repository credentials, and reran the failed job.
close_notes: Backup completed successfully and restore-point verification passed.

description: A production integration receives HTTP 401 responses after an application secret rotation.
resolution_notes: Updated the secret reference in the integration configuration and restarted the connector service.
close_notes: API authentication succeeded and queued transactions were processed.

description: Administrators experience frozen RDP sessions when connecting to a Windows jump server.
resolution_notes: Restarted Remote Desktop Services, cleared disconnected sessions, and updated the network adapter driver.
close_notes: Multiple 30-minute RDP sessions completed without freezing.

description: Monitoring reports that the public API TLS certificate will expire within seven days.
resolution_notes: Renewed the certificate, updated the application gateway listener, and verified the full certificate chain.
close_notes: External TLS tests confirmed the new expiration date and trusted chain.

description: A user account locks every few minutes after a password change.
resolution_notes: Identified stored old credentials on a mobile mail client, removed the saved password, and unlocked the account.
close_notes: No additional lockouts occurred during the monitoring period.
